explication: Coder is a self-hosted platform for Terraform-defined cloud workspaces and infrastructure-hosted AI coding agents. The principal workflow is: a developer or automation client submits a template and workspace request; the control plane builds and provisions resources, connects agents over the secure tailnet, and exposes the workspace to IDEs. AI chats use the control-plane gateway to reach governed model providers and agent tools. Sampled files strongly support chat routing, agent context/file indexing, MCP management, notifications, and tailnet coordination; several broader product capabilities are represented at their documented package paths.
